text: And to zoom in on one very specific example, let's say the hope

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: The question at hand is what parameters should the network have?

text: What dials and knobs should you be able to tweak so that it's expressive

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: enough to potentially capture this pattern, or any other pixel pattern,

text: or the pattern that several edges can make a loop, and other such things?

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: Well, what we'll do is assign a weight to each one of the

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1

text: little grid of their own, and I'm going to use green pixels to indicate

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: Now if we made the weights associated with almost all of the pixels zero

text: except for some positive weights in this region that we care about,

text: then taking the weighted sum of all the pixel values really just amounts

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: to adding up the values of the pixel just in the region that we care about.

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: And if you really wanted to pick up on whether there's an edge here,

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: When you compute a weighted sum like this, you might come out with any number,

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: So a common thing to do is to pump this weighted sum into some function

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: And a common function that does this is called the sigmoid function,

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: also known as a logistic curve.

title: But what is a neural network? | Deep learning chapter 1
text: Basically very negative inputs end up close to 0, positive inputs end up close to 1,

text: and it just steadily increases around the input 0.

text: So the activation of the neuron here is basically a

text: But maybe it's not that you want the neuron to

text: Maybe you only want it to be active when the sum is bigger than say 10.

text: That is, you want some bias for it to be inactive.

text: That additional number is called the bias.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So, I'll be speaking to you
using language ...

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: because I can.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
This is one these magical abilities
that we humans have.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
We can transmit really complicated
thoughts to one another.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So what I'm doing right now is,
I'm making sounds with my mouth

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: as I'm exhaling.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: I'm making tones and hisses and puffs,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and those are creating
air vibrations in the air.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Those air vibrations are traveling to you,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: they're hitting your eardrums,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and then your brain takes
those vibrations from your eardrums

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and transforms them into thoughts.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: I hope.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: (Laughter)

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: I hope that's happening.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So because of this ability,
we humans are able to transmit our ideas

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: across vast reaches of space and time.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
We're able to transmit
knowledge across minds.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
I can put a bizarre new idea
in your mind right now.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: I could say,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: "Imagine a jellyfish waltzing in a library

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: while thinking about quantum mechanics."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: (Laughter)

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Now, if everything has gone
relatively well in your life so far,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
you probably haven't had
that thought before.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: (Laughter)

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: But now I've just made you think it,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: through language.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Now of course, there isn't just
one language in the world,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
there are about 7,000 languages
spoken around the world.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
And all the languages differ
from one another in all kinds of ways.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Some languages have different sounds,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: they have different vocabularies,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and they also have different structures --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: very importantly, different structures.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: That begs the question:

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Does the language we speak
shape the way we think?

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Now, this is an ancient question.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
People have been speculating
about this question forever.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Charlemagne, Holy Roman emperor, said,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
"To have a second language
is to have a second soul" --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
strong statement
that language crafts reality.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
But on the other hand,
Shakespeare has Juliet say,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: "What's in a name?

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
A rose by any other name
would smell as sweet."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Well, that suggests that maybe
language doesn't craft reality.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
These arguments have gone
back and forth for thousands of years.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
But until recently,
there hasn't been any data

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: to help us decide either way.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Recently, in my lab
and other labs around the world,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: we've started doing research,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and now we have actual scientific data
to weigh in on this question.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So let me tell you about
some of my favorite examples.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
I'll start with an example
from an Aboriginal community in Australia

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: that I had the chance to work with.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: These are the Kuuk Thaayorre people.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
They live in Pormpuraaw
at the very west edge of Cape York.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: What's cool about Kuuk Thaayorre is,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
in Kuuk Thaayorre, they don't use
words like "left" and "right,"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and instead, everything
is in cardinal directions:

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: north, south, east and west.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
And when I say everything,
I really mean everything.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: You would say something like,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
"Oh, there's an ant
on your southwest leg."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Or, "Move your cup

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
In fact, the way that you say "hello"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: "Which way are you going?"

text: And the answer should be,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: "North-northeast in the far distance.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: How about you?"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So imagine as you're walking

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: every person you greet,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED

Because you literally
couldn't get past "hello,"

if you didn't know

text:
very egocentric of me to have
the direction of time chase me around

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: every time I turn my body.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
For the Kuuk Thaayorre,
time is locked on the landscape.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
It's a dramatically different way
of thinking about time.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Here's another really smart human trick.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Suppose I ask you
how many penguins are there.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Well, I bet I know how you'd solve
that problem if you solved it.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
You went, "One, two, three,
four, five, six, seven, eight."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: You counted them.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: You named each one with a number,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and the last number you said
was the number of penguins.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
This is a little trick
that you're taught to use as kids.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
You learn the number list
and you learn how to apply it.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: A little linguistic trick.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Well, some languages don't do this,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
because some languages
don't have exact number words.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
They're languages that don't have
a word like "seven"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: or a word like "eight."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
In fact, people who speak
these languages don't count,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and they have trouble
keeping track of exact quantities.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So, for example, if I ask you
to match this number of penguins

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: to the same number of ducks,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: you would be able to do that by counting.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
But folks who don't have
that linguistic trick can't do that.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Languages also differ in how
they divide up the color spectrum --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: the visual world.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Some languages have
lots of words for colors,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
some have only a couple words,
"light" and "dark."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
And languages differ in where they put
boundaries between colors.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So, for example, in English,
there's a word for blue

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
that covers all of the colors
that you can see on the screen,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: but in Russian, there isn't a single word.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Instead, Russian speakers
have to differentiate

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: between light blue, "goluboy,"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and dark blue, "siniy."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So Russians have this lifetime
of experience of, in language,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: distinguishing these two colors.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
When we test people's ability
to perceptually discriminate these colors,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
what we find is that
Russian speakers are faster

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: across this linguistic boundary.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
They're faster to be able
to tell the difference

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: between a light and dark blue.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
And when you look at people's brains
as they're looking at colors --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
say you have colors shifting slowly
from light to dark blue --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
the brains of people who use
different words for light and dark blue

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
will give a surprised reaction
as the colors shift from light to dark,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
as if, "Ooh, something
has categorically changed,"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
whereas the brains
of English speakers, for example,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
that don't make
this categorical distinction,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: don't give that surprise,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: because nothing is categorically changing.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Languages have all kinds
of structural quirks.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: This is one of my favorites.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Lots of languages have grammatical gender;

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
every noun gets assigned a gender,
often masculine or feminine.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: And these genders differ across languages.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So, for example, the sun is feminine
in German but masculine in Spanish,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and the moon, the reverse.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Could this actually have any
consequence for how people think?

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Do German speakers think of the sun
as somehow more female-like,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and the moon somehow more male-like?

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Actually, it turns out that's the case.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So if you ask German and Spanish speakers
to, say, describe a bridge,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: like the one here --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
"bridge" happens to be grammatically
feminine in German,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: grammatically masculine in Spanish --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
German speakers are more likely
to say bridges are "beautiful," "elegant"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and stereotypically feminine words.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Whereas Spanish speakers
will be more likely to say

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: they're "strong" or "long,"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: these masculine words.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: (Laughter)

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Languages also differ in how
they describe events, right?

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: You take an event like this, an accident.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
In English, it's fine to say,
"He broke the vase."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: In a language like Spanish,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
you might be more likely
to say, "The vase broke,"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: or, "The vase broke itself."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
If it's an accident, you wouldn't say
that someone did it.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
In English, quite weirdly,
we can even say things like,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: "I broke my arm."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Now, in lots of languages,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
you couldn't use that construction
unless you are a lunatic

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and you went out
looking to break your arm --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: (Laughter)

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and you succeeded.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
If it was an accident,
you would use a different construction.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Now, this has consequences.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So, people who speak different languages
will pay attention to different things,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
depending on what their language
usually requires them to do.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So we show the same accident
to English speakers and Spanish speakers,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: English speakers will remember who did it,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
because English requires you
to say, "He did it; he broke the vase."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Whereas Spanish speakers might be
less likely to remember who did it

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: if it's an accident,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
but they're more likely to remember
that it was an accident.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
They're more likely
to remember the intention.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: So, two people watch the same event,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: witness the same crime,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
but end up remembering
different things about that event.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
This has implications, of course,
for eyewitness testimony.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
It also has implications
for blame and punishment.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: So if you take English speakers

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and I just show you
someone breaking a vase,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and I say, "He broke the vase,"
as opposed to "The vase broke,"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: even though you can witness it yourself,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: you can watch the video,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: you can watch the crime against the vase,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: you will punish someone more,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
you will blame someone more
if I just said, "He broke it,"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: as opposed to, "It broke."

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
The language guides
our reasoning about events.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Now, I've given you a few examples

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
of how language can profoundly
shape the way we think,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and it does so in a variety of ways.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: So language can have big effects,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: like we saw with space and time,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: where people can lay out space and time

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
in completely different
coordinate frames from each other.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Language can also have
really deep effects --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
that's what we saw
with the case of number.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Having count words in your language,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: having number words,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: opens up the whole world of mathematics.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Of course, if you don't count,
you can't do algebra,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: you can't do any of the things

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
that would be required
to build a room like this

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: or make this broadcast, right?

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
This little trick of number words
gives you a stepping stone

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: into a whole cognitive realm.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Language can also have
really early effects,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: what we saw in the case of color.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
These are really simple,
basic, perceptual decisions.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: We make thousands of them all the time,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and yet, language is getting in there

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
and fussing even with these tiny little
perceptual decisions that we make.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Language can have really broad effects.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So the case of grammatical gender
may be a little silly,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
but at the same time,
grammatical gender applies to all nouns.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
That means language can shape
how you're thinking

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
about anything that can be
named by a noun.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: That's a lot of stuff.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
And finally, I gave you an example
of how language can shape things

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: that have personal weight to us --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
ideas like blame and punishment
or eyewitness memory.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
These are important things
in our daily lives.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Now, the beauty of linguistic diversity
is that it reveals to us

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
just how ingenious and how flexible
the human mind is.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
Human minds have invented
not one cognitive universe, but 7,000 --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
there are 7,000 languages
spoken around the world.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: And we can create many more --

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: languages, of course, are living things,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
things that we can hone
and change to suit our needs.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
The tragic thing is that we're losing
so much of this linguistic diversity

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: all the time.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: We're losing about one language a week,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and by some estimates,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
half of the world's languages
will be gone in the next hundred years.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: And the even worse news is that right now,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
almost everything we know about
the human mind and human brain

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
is based on studies of usually American
English-speaking undergraduates

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: at universities.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: That excludes almost all humans. Right?

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
So what we know about the human mind
is actually incredibly narrow and biased,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: and our science has to do better.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
I want to leave you
with this final thought.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
I've told you about how speakers
of different languages think differently,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
but of course, that's not about
how people elsewhere think.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: It's about how you think.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text:
It's how the language that you speak
shapes the way that you think.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: And that gives you the opportunity to ask,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: "Why do I think the way that I do?"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: "How could I think differently?"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: And also,

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: "What thoughts do I wish to create?"

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: Thank you very much.

title: How Language Shapes the Way We Think | Lera Boroditsky | TED
text: (Applause)

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
This level can increase by up to two orders
of magnitude during a flare.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Not only does Proxima Centauri have more intense
solar activity than our sun, it also has a

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: higher frequency of it.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
It is estimated that 88% of the star's surface
is active at any given time.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
This is way higher than our sun, even at the
peak of its solar cycle.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Before you start thinking of Proxima Centauri
as a fiery ball of fury, remember - we are

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: comparing apples and oranges here.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: Our sun is not a red dwarf.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
In fact, compared to other red dwarfs, Proxima
Centauri is considered to have a low activity

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: level.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Unlike the sun which scientists estimate will
only burn through 10% of its hydrogen supply

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
before burning out, Proxima Centauri is predicted
to use up almost all its fuel before leaving

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: the main sequence in about four trillion years.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
And by then, Earth, our sun, and our whole
solar system will all be long gone.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Alpha Centauri AB is 0.13 light years, or
2 trillion kilometres, away from Proxima Centauri.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
You might be wondering - "if Proxima Centauri
is so far away from its companion stars, why

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
is it considered part of the same stellar
system?"

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Well, we have data that shows it is gravitationally
bound to the Alpha Centauri AB binary star,

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
making it part of the stellar system with
an orbital period of about 550,000 years.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
How it ended up in this orbital situation
is still open to speculation.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: But the two main scenarios seem to be either:

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
One: Proxima Centauri was bound to the Alpha
Centauri system during its formation, meaning

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
the stars likely share the same elemental
composition,

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Or Two: Proxima Centauri was captured by the
binary star's gravity during an encounter,

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
leading to a highly eccentric orbit that was
later stabilised by the galactic tide and

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: further stellar encounters.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Regardless of how Proxima Centauri got into
this triplet, calculations suggest that in

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: 3.5 billion years it will get out.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
As Alpha Centauri AB continues to evolve and
lose mass over its lifetime, Proxima Centauri

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: will unbind from the system.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The binary star system itself is also predicted
to disassociate and diverge in about 12 billion

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
years, into two white dwarfs which will forge
independent and steadily diverging paths.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Being our closest neighbours, we know quite
a lot about Alpha Centauri AB.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
But we'll go into more detail about this binary
star system in another video.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: For now, it's all eyes on Proxima Centauri.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The search for exoplanets around Proxima Centauri
had been ongoing since the mid-2000s, without

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: much luck.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
But researchers weren’t willing to give
up - not only was this star the closest neighbour

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
we had, it was also a red dwarf - 20-40% of
which have a planet orbiting in a habitable

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: zone.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: The patience paid off.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Observations at the European Southern Observatory
in Chile identified anomalies in Proxima Centauri

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
which couldn't be explained by flares or other
solar activity.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The data seemed to indicate there may be a
planet orbiting it.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
In January 2016, the Pale Red Dot campaign
- a coordinated effort from multidisciplinary

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
scientists and ground-based telescopes around
the world - was launched to see if this suspected

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: planet could be identified.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
In August of the same year, the discovery
of exoplanet Proxima Centauri b was announced.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
It is at least 1.07 times larger than Earth,
and sits 20 times closer to Proxima Centauri

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: than we do to our sun.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
This exoplanet orbits its star in just 11.2
Earth-days.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Even though Proxima B is within Proxima Centauri's
habitable zone, that's not to say it could

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: sustain life.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
There's lots of other factors that determine
habitability than liquid water.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
For one, the intense solar activity would
pelt the planet with 10 to 60 times the amount

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
of UV and X-ray radiation we get here on Earth
- we'd need to develop SPF 3,000 to make the

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: journey worth it.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Another factor to consider is whether an atmosphere
could survive under such conditions.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
As far as we know, atmospheres are vital for
the maintenance of a water-friendly surface

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
pressure, protection from dangerous space
weather, and planetary climate regulation.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The radiation Proxima B is exposed to might
be enough to strip away the key components

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: of an atmosphere over time.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Frustratingly, we don't know much about Proxima
B beyond its distance from its star, and its

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: orbital period.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
It is unlikely to have any moons, due to the
instability of their orbits on larger timescales,

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
but it is thought the planet itself is tidally
locked to its star.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
As discussed in a recent video, this doesn't
bode well for potential habitability.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
It also likely developed under extremely different
conditions from Earth.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Assuming it formed at the current distance
from its star, it would have gone through

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
a much faster evolution, with stronger impacts
and less water.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: However, there is some debate about its formation.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Some scientists think the amount of material
in the protoplanetary disk would be insufficient

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
for it to form at its current distance from
the star.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
It's more likely, they say, that the planet
formed farther away from its star and eventually

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
drifted into its current orbit around Proxima
Centauri.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
What the surface of the planet might look
like is down to pure speculation.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Theories range from a planet covered in ice,
to planet-wide oceans like Earth - though

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
unlikely if the planet is indeed tidally locked
- to a water-free world with only dry land,

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: or a subsurface ocean like Europa.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: In short - no idea.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
We haven't directly imaged the planet yet,
so we'll have to wait for the first flyby

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
to get a better idea - which some moguls are
already planning.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
If it happens, I have a feeling it will be
just as Earth-shattering as the Voyager flybys

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: in the 70s and 80s - but more on that later.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
6 years after the discovery of Proxima B,
the news of Proxima D swept global headlines.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The first signs of the planet emerged in 2020,
when a weak 5.15 day signal was detected in

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
the radial velocity data during a study on
Proxima B's mass.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Following further data collection and analysis,
scientists announced the discovery of Proxima

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: D in February 2022.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
So far, we know it is a sub-Earth planet,
with at least 25% the mass of Earth, orbiting

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: the star every 5.1 days.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Sitting at a distance of 4.3 million kilometres,
it orbits too close to have a habitable equilibrium

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
temperature, which would be driven up to 87
degrees Celsius.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
It's also probably tidally locked, and would
be pelted with so much radiation that chances

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: of finding life there are very slim.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
But, this planet holds promise in another
realm.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
It is the lightest planet to ever be detected
with the radial velocity method.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Since the planet is too far to be seen with
telescopes, scientists rely on a characteristic

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
"wobble" anomaly in the movement of a star
that indicates the potential presence of a

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: planet.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The more massive the planet, the more obvious
the wobble.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
In the case of Proxima D, the wobble was practically
imperceptible.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
To me, the fact we caught the wobble and were
then able to demonstrate with enough certainty

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
that it is caused by a planet is a technological
milestone worth celebrating.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
If only the world of astronomy were so cut
and dry.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Where there is breakthrough and celebration
on one end, there is bleak uncertainty on

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: the other.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
That's exactly where you'll find the controversial
exoplanet Proxima C.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Initially detected in 2019 using the same
radial velocity method that found Proxima

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
D, the existence of Proxima C was then confirmed
in 2020 using Hubble astrometry data.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
However, in 2022, another team challenged
the initial radial velocity data that led

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: to the alleged discovery.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
They claimed the anomalies could have instead
been associated with small, unaccounted systematic

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
errors in the data extraction method the researchers
used.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: Basically, a miscalibration.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The trouble arises from the fact that unlike
Proxima D which orbits incredibly close to

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
its star, the data for alleged exoplanet Proxima
C places it very far away from its star - with

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: an estimated 1,928 day orbit.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
“There is no similar example of a wobble
detection of a planet with such a low amplitude

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: at such a long period.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
That doesn’t necessarily mean it’s wrong,
but it is going to require some confirmation

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
from additional observations,” says Paul
Robertson, astronomer at University of California

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: Irvine.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
If Proxima C does exist, it will take a bit
more data to convince reluctant sceptics.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
If it does not exist, it remains unclear why
the Hubble astrometric data was able to corroborate

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: and confirm a planetary signature.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
I guess we'll just have to wait and see what
future studies find.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
With the recent discovery of Proxima B and
how relatively close Proxima Centauri is to

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
us, it is a perfect candidate for a future
flyby.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
However, reaching our neighbouring star system
will take thousands of years using conventional

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: propulsion technologies.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Newer techniques like solar sails or nuclear
propulsion might make such a trip possible

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: within a human lifetime.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Such ideas spearheaded the development of
Project Breakthrough Starshot - an initiative

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
set up by investor and physicist Yuri Milner,
the late Stephen Hawking, and Mark Zuckerberg

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
- which aims to reach the Alpha Centauri system
within the first half of the 21st century.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The idea is to conduct a flyby mission by
sending microprobes weighing just a few grams

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
at 15-20% the speed of light, and they think
they could do it as early as 2036.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
With this timeline, the probes would reach
Alpha Centauri in 20 years, and we on Earth

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: would receive the first data 4 years later.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
After the initial flyby, the probes would
possibly venture to the exoplanets and collect

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
data on their atmospheric compositions, much
like the Voyager missions did on our outer

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: solar system decades ago.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The team is pinning their hopes on the yet-to-be-developed
StarChip, a microelectronic gram-scale wafer,

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
carrying cameras, photon thrusters, power
supply, navigation and communication equipment

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
- essentially constituting a fully functional
space probe.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Based on Moore's law, which states that the
speed and capability of computers can be expected

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: to double every two years.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Bold and ambitious, the plan is not without
its challenges.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
The team proposes to power these microprobes
with 100 gigawatts of Earth-based lasers.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
That's the equivalent of the output of 100
large nuclear power plants, concentrated on

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: probes just centimetres wide.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Plus, all components of these tiny probes
must be built to withstand extreme acceleration,

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text: cold, vacuum, and collisions with space dust.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
With this in mind, perhaps the project would
more aptly be named Project Breakthrough Longshot.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
But if the history of space exploration has
taught us anything, it is that missions confronted

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
with cruel hardship and slim odds can emerge
as triumphant milestones of humanity.

title: The Closest Planet Outside Our Solar System Is Within Reach | Proxima Centauri
text:
Proxima Centauri might just be the next one
for the history books.

text: Let's just hope we're around to see it.
